# Phase Two — Improved Brainstorm

The better architecture is an evidence-first audit with isolated specialist lanes.

## Lanes

- Architecture and import graph.
- Character identity and body diversity.
- Face, viseme, gaze, blink, and head turn.
- Body acting, gesture phases, contact locks, hands, shoes.
- Garments, hair, secondary motion.
- Camera, shots, text, titles, and timing.
- Customizer, serialization, import, restoration.
- Preview, browser, export, package, metadata.
- Pixel courts and perceptual review.
- Compliance, regression suite, and completion gate.

Each lane returns exact files, tests, browser/export evidence, defects, remaining work, and next action. The master rereads all changed files and reruns the whole chain.
